error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: This screen could not be displayed. Reload the page to try again.

home.title: Hospital management system
home.description: What needs attention at this hospital today.
home.empty: There is nothing to show here for your role yet.
home.widgetFailed: This panel could not be shown. The rest of the page still works.

errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.timeout: The server took too long to respond. Try again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this.
errors.not_found: This item could not be found.
errors.conflict: This was changed by someone else. Reload and try again.
errors.validation: Some details are not valid. Check them and try again.
errors.rate_limited: The system is busy. Try again in a moment.
errors.server: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.

login.title: Sign in
login.invalid: The email or password is not correct, or the account is temporarily locked. Check them and try again.
login.rateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
login.mfaIntro: Enter the code from your authenticator app to finish signing in.
login.mfaHint: Six digits from the app, or one of your recovery codes.
login.mfaTimedOut: The code step timed out. Sign in again.
login.mfaInvalid: That code is not correct. Check it and try again.
login.mfaCodeNeeded: Enter the code from your authenticator app.

ended.idle: You were signed out because the app was not used for a while.
ended.expired: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
ended.signed_out_elsewhere: You signed out in another tab.

security.title: Security
security.intro: Protect your account with a code from an authenticator app. Once it is on, signing in asks for the code as well as your password.
security.scan: Scan this code with an authenticator app, such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator.
security.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
security.manual: Cannot scan it? Enter this key in the app:
security.passwordHint: Enter your password to confirm it is you.
security.alreadyOn: An authenticator is already set up for your account. Reload this page.
security.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the codes above and copy them by hand.
security.invalidCode: That code is not correct. Check the code in the app and try again.
security.codesIntro: Keep these recovery codes somewhere safe. Each works once if you lose your authenticator. They are shown only now.
security.enabled: An authenticator is set up for your account.
security.regenerateIntro: Your old recovery codes stop working. Enter your password and a code from the authenticator app.
security.turnOffIntro: Signing in will ask for your password only. Enter your password and a code from the authenticator app.
security.requiredHere: A hospital you work at requires an authenticator, so it cannot be turned off.
security.appCodeHint: Six digits from the app. A recovery code does not work here.
security.invalidAppCode: That code is not correct. Enter the six digits shown in the app now.
security.sharedPc: On a shared computer, do not leave these codes on the screen. The clipboard is emptied a minute after you copy them.
security.leaveBlocked: Your recovery codes are shown only once. Tick that you have saved them before you leave this page.

account.signedInBody: {{name}} is signed in on this computer. Sign them out to continue with this link.
account.passwordHint: At least {{count}} characters. Avoid common words and sequences.
account.passwordTooShort: The password needs at least 12 characters.
account.passwordTooCommon: That password is too easy to guess. Choose a less obvious one.
account.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
account.invalidLinkBody: The link may have expired or already been used. Ask for a new one.
account.inviteIntro: You have been invited to {{hospital}} as {{email}}.
account.inviteDoneBody: You can now sign in to {{hospital}}.
account.forgotIntro: Enter your email. If it has an account, we will send a link to choose a new password.
account.forgotDoneBody: If that address has an account, a link to reset the password is on its way.
account.resetDoneBody: Your password has been changed. Sign in with the new one.

tenancy.pickerDescription: You work at more than one hospital. Pick the one you want to open.
tenancy.suspendedDescription: This hospital's access to Mediflow is paused. Its data is safe. Contact your hospital administrator for details.

desktopOnly.title: This screen needs a wider display
desktopOnly.description: It needs a window at least 1024 pixels wide. Widen the window, lower the zoom, or turn a tablet on its side.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: This address does not match any screen. It may have been mistyped, or the page may have moved.

notice.tenantChangedElsewhere: The active hospital was changed in another tab. This tab now shows the same hospital.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.description: What platform administrators did, newest first. Ids and codes only, never a hospital's data.
audit.actorHint: Paste the id of a platform administrator to see only what they did.

home.title: Platform administration
home.description: Hospitals, their modules and the platform audit trail are managed from here. No hospital's patient data is reachable from this area.

hospitals.title: Hospitals
hospitals.description: Every hospital on the platform, with its status and head count. No patient data is shown here.

create.title: New hospital
create.description: Set up a hospital in three steps. Its first administrator is invited afterwards.
create.name: Hospital name
create.slugHint: Lower case letters, digits and single hyphens. Suggested from the name.
create.regionHint: Where the hospital's data is kept.
create.localeHint: A language tag such as en-IN. It sets the language and the date and number formats.
create.colourHint: Six-digit hex such as #0f766e. It must be dark enough to read as text on white.
create.logoHint: An https address of the logo. Optional.
create.previewNone: Enter a valid colour to see a preview.
create.modulesHint: Modules left off can be switched on later.
create.limitHint: A whole number. Leave empty for no limit.

errors.slug: Use lower case letters, digits and single hyphens.
errors.slugTaken: A hospital already has this slug. Choose another.
errors.locale: This is not a valid language tag.
errors.timezone: This is not a known time zone.
errors.currency: This is not a known currency.
errors.colour: Use a six-digit hex colour such as #0f766e.
errors.colourContrast: This colour is too light to read as text on white. Choose a darker one.
errors.logo: Use an address that starts with https://.
errors.whole: Enter a whole number above zero, or leave it empty.

detail.title: Hospital
detail.notFoundBody: There is no hospital with this address.
detail.errorTitle: The hospital could not be loaded
detail.modulesHint: A module that is off is hidden from this hospital's staff. A change reaches them at their next policy refresh, with no sign-out.
detail.limitsHint: Leave a limit empty for none. Limits are recorded here; they are not enforced yet.
detail.conflict: Someone else changed this hospital meanwhile. What you typed is kept; review it and save again.
detail.theySaved: Saved by someone else for fields you also changed:

status.heading: Status
status.deleteAfter: Its data may be deleted after {{when}}; nothing is deleted yet.
status.changedMeanwhile: The hospital's status was changed by someone else. It is shown again as it is now.

explain.active: Open. Its staff can sign in.
explain.suspended: Closed to its staff. Its data is kept.
explain.offboarding: Closed to its staff, and marked for deletion. Its data is kept for now.

suspend.title: Suspend {{name}}?
suspend.description: Its staff are signed out now and cannot sign in until it is reactivated. Open invites are withdrawn. Nothing is deleted.

description.suspended: Its staff can sign in again. Invites withdrawn when it was suspended are not restored.
description.offboarding: This cancels the offboarding and clears the deletion date. Its staff can sign in again.

offboard.title: Offboard {{name}}?
offboard.description: Its staff are signed out now, open invites are withdrawn, and its data is marked for deletion after the days below. The export and the deletion are not built yet: nothing is deleted. Reactivating cancels this.
offboard.slugMismatch: This is not the hospital's slug.
offboard.days: Days until its data may be deleted
offboard.daysInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 3650.

invite.heading: First hospital admin
invite.hint: Invite the person who will run this hospital. They get an email with a link to set a password and an authenticator. Once the hospital has an admin, its admins invite their own staff.
invite.name: Name
invite.hasAdmin: This hospital already has an admin. Its admins invite their own staff.
invite.notActive: The hospital is not active, so it cannot be sent an invite.
invite.notAllowed: This address cannot be invited. Check it and try again.

access.forbiddenTitle: You do not have access to this page
access.forbiddenDescription: If you think you should, ask your hospital administrator to update your role.

validation.too_small: This value is too short or too small.
validation.too_big: This value is too long or too large.
validation.invalid_format: This value is not in the expected format.
validation.plain_text: This text has a character that cannot be seen. Type it again instead of pasting it.
validation.end_after_start: The end must be after the start.
validation.invalid_value: Choose one of the available options.

link.title: Opening a link
link.unavailableDescription: It may be for a hospital you do not work at, or the item may no longer exist. Nothing has been opened.

idle.title: Are you still there?
idle.description_one: You will be signed out in {{count}} second because the app has not been used.
idle.description_other: You will be signed out in {{count}} seconds because the app has not been used.

profile.title: Your account
profile.name: Name
profile.authenticatorOff: No authenticator is set up for your account.
profile.passwordChanged: Your password has been changed. Your other sessions were signed out.
profile.passwordUnchanged: The new password is the same as the current one. Choose a different one.
profile.accountLocked: Too many wrong attempts. Your account is locked for a few minutes. Try again later.
profile.sessionsIntro: End a session you do not recognise, or one on a computer you no longer use. That browser is signed out the next time it does anything.
